notes.note: Chose reading 1 (all table 20 operations). The violation is a create operation in a function that is called only from the control part, so it does not run in a test case or PTC behaviour. Titan accepts this because it does not check how the function is invoked; it only forbids the operation inside the control part itself.

Hard to observe directly. The test checks that self.stop on the MTC ends the test case, as it would for a normal component, and keeps the verdict set before the stop. It does not cover other differences between normal and alive components.
Covers a normal PTC whose behaviour has terminated and an alive PTC that was killed. The case 'not created' (an unbound or null reference) is not covered.
